title: Freeze Agent-operated OS and ecosystem chain
purpose: Freeze the unified chain that makes Agent Runtime the OS control plane and aom the safe ecosystem extension manager.
scope: Declare that Linux is the deterministic substrate while Agent Runtime is the AgentOS control plane.
Bind ecosystem activation to AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
Prevent aom from becoming a second privileged runtime.
Record non-goals and inherited safety invariants.
implementation_steps: Review existing AgentCore, SecurityExecution and functional-ready constraints.
Record which runtime layer owns each responsibility.
Create evidence with accepted and rejected shortcuts.
acceptance_criteria: The chain says Agent Runtime operates OS control loops.
aom install/stage is separate from activation.
verification: Confirm docs mention AgentCore, SecurityExecutionEngine, aom and install/stage != activate.
failure_modes: The chain treats aom as traditional package manager only.
The chain permits ecosystem activation outside SecurityExecutionEngine.
